description: This Python script generates new recipe scraper modules and associated test data, including code templating, file management, and registration within the project.

classes.name: _TemplateReplacer
classes.description: Handles code templating by replacing placeholder class and host names in the scraper template code.

classes.name: _InitRegistrar
classes.description: Manages the registration of new scraper classes in the __init__.py file, including import statements and host mappings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating scraper generation, test data creation, and registration based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: _generate_scraper
methods.description: Creates a new scraper Python file from a template, replacing placeholders with class name and host.

methods.name: _generate_tests_and_data
methods.description: Generates test HTML and JSON data files for the new scraper.

methods.name: _register_scraper
methods.description: Updates __init__.py to include the new scraper class and its host mapping.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Method of _TemplateReplacer that applies placeholder replacements in the code.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Returns the modified code after placeholder replacements.
